# HOLLOW-001 — fixture PID whose every required section is empty

Proves: headings alone are not a PID. Identity is satisfied — this heading
names `HOLLOW-001` — and all four required sections are present and spelled
exactly as the validator accepts them, so the *only* thing wrong with this
document is that every one of those sections has nothing in it. All four
section reasons fire and the identity reason does not.

This is the shape a template produces when it is copied and not filled in,
which is why it is a committed fixture rather than a temporary one.
